title: Store the original HTML alongside extracted blocks
roadmap_anchor: Q1 > Durability > Store the original HTML
acceptance: Post gains a compressed original-HTML field in SwiftData external storage
New saves persist it through both the app and the share extension path
A migration leaves existing posts intact and readable, with the field empty
Library and reader performance at 100 posts is unchanged
notes: Reverses an earlier call; without it nothing can ever be re-extracted. Data-model change — highest-risk item in Q1.
